events.verdict: Shamet (NYK) and Holmgren (OKC) briefly engage and disengage during rebounding.
Wallace (OKC) applies his hand to Brunson's (NYK) front and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Dort (OKC) extends his left forearm into Hart (NYK) and dislodges him from his rebounding position.
Hart (NYK) establishes himself in Wallace's (OKC) path prior to the contact.
Holmgren (OKC) is moving alongside Brunson's (NYK) path as he defends the drive.
Wallace (OKC) makes contact with the ball as he defends Hart's (NYK) shot near the rim.
Dort (OKC) firms up over his right leg in Bridges' (NYK) path prior to the contact.
Hart (NYK) and Joe (OKC) come together at the same spot off-ball and the contact is marginal.
Anunoby (NYK) legally contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
Wallace (OKC) legally contests Hart's (NYK) shot attempt.
Dort (OKC) initiates contact with Brunson (NYK), who has established a legal guarding position in his path prior to the contact.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) is moving alongside Brunson's (NYK) path as he defends the drive.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Anunoby (NYK) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.

Shamet (NYK) extends his forearm into Holmgren's (OKC) path and initiates contact that affects his SQBR.  This contact occurs prior to, and causes, any ensuing contact from Holmgren to Shamet's upper body.
Wallace (OKC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Knicks.
Anunoby (NYK) establishes himself in Wallace's (OKC) path prior to the contact.
Wallace (OKC) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Williams (OKC) legally contests Anunoby's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
